description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josh Downs practiced on Tuesday.
items.impact: Downs missed time last week with a calf issue. He is on track to be good to go for the season opener next week.
items.title: Josh Downs (calf) practices Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Alec Pierce practiced on Tuesday.
items.impact: Pierce missed most of training camp while recovering from offseason ankle surgery. He appears to be on track to be good to go for Week 1, though it is unclear if he will be limited in any way.
items.title: Alec Pierce (ankle) practices Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyler Warren was able to practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Warren has been working his way back from a minor groin issue. He should be good to go for Week 1 next week.
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) practices Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: 49ers GM John Lynch said he hopes Mike Evans will practice next week.
items.impact: Evans has been absent from practice for much of the past few weeks. He will likely need to log multiple practices early next week to have a good chance of playing in Week 1 against the Rams.
items.title: Mike Evans (adductor) hopeful to return to practice next week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty was not seen practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Jeanty remains uncertain for Week 1. The fact that he avoided being placed on injured reserve is a positive sign he is expected to miss fewer than four games if he isn't ready to go to begin the season.
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) not seen practicing Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jonathon Brooks was seen working on the side with trainers during practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: It is unclear what the exact reasoning is. There could be an update after practice. Brooks figures to enter the season complementing Chuba Hubbard.
items.title: Jonathon Brooks working with trainers on side during practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens signed K'Von Wallace to their practice squad.
items.impact: Wallace will remain in a depth role in the Ravens secondary.
items.title: K'Von Wallace signs with Ravens practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed CB Trevon Diggs to their practice squad.
items.impact: Diggs will remain in a depth role in the secondary for Seattle.
items.title: Trevon Diggs signs with Seahawks practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos signed TE Lucas Krull to their practice squad.
items.impact: Krull will remain in a depth role in the Broncos tight end room.
items.title: Lucas Krull signs with Broncos practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions signed TE Thomas Gordon to their practice squad.
items.impact: Gordon will hold a depth role in the Lions tight end room.
items.title: Thomas Gordon signs with Lions practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills signed veteran S Geno Stone to the practice squad.
items.impact: Stone is expected to be on the active roster in Week 1.
items.title: Geno Stone signs with Bills practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders signed RB Craig Reynolds to their practice squad.
items.impact: Reynolds will be in a depth role in the Commanders backfield.
items.title: Craig Reynolds signs with Commanders practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders signed C Julian Good-Jones to their practice squad.
items.impact: Good-Jones will be in a depth role on the Commanders offensive line.
items.title: Julian Good-Jones signs with Commanders practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders signed WR Jaden Bradley to their practice squad.
items.impact: Bradley will remain in a depth role in the Commanders wide receiver room.
items.title: Jaden Bradley signs with Commanders practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders re-signed QB Sam Hartman to their practice squad.
items.impact: Hartman will remain in a depth role in the Commanders quarterback room.
items.title: Sam Hartman signs with Commanders practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos signed Calvin Throckmorton to their practice squad.
items.impact: Throckmorton will hold a depth role heading into the season.
items.title: Calvin Throckmorton signs with Broncos practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos re-signed Kolbe Katsis to their practice squad.
items.impact: Katsis will add depth in the wide receiver room for Denver.
items.title: Kolbe Katsis returns to Broncos practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts re-signed offensive tackle Roy Mbaeteka.
items.impact: Mbaeteka was originally signed by the New York Giants. He will add depth on the defensive line.
items.title: Roy Mbaeteka re-signs with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans waived safety Jerrick Reed II.
items.impact: Reed will seek a depth role with another team heading into the season.
items.title: Jerrick Reed II waived by Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans waived LB Mohamoud Diabate.
items.impact: Diabate will seek a depth role in another opportunity later in the season.
items.title: Mohamoud Diabate waived by Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins signed DE Malik Herring to their active roster.
items.impact: Herring will add depth on the defensive line for Miami.
items.title: Malik Herring signs with Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed QB Jake Haener to their practice squad.
items.impact: Haener will add depth in the quarterback room for the Giants.
items.title: Jake Haener signs with Giants practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers waived OG Chandler Zavala.
items.impact: Zavala has played in 34 games with 14 starts over three seasons. He'll figure to draw interest on waivers.
items.title: Chandler Zavala waived by Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints signed S Terrell Burgess to their active roster.
items.impact: Burgess was previously released by New Orleans.
items.title: Terrell Burgess signs with Saints

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings released rookie WR Dillon Bell.
items.impact: Bell was an undrafted free agent out of Georgia. He could draw interest on waivers.
items.title: Dillon Bell released by Vikings
